items.title: 14.14 Strategies used to reduce air pollution (air pollution kam karne ke tareeqe) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 14.14 with Figure 14.6, printed pages 317-318.

blocks.text: Air pollution kam karne aur air quality behtar karne ke liye kai technologies istemal hoti hain. Kitab kehti hai ke pollutants ka emission control karne ke liye 'paanch' types ki technologies hain, lekin neeche chaar hi di gai hain:

Gariyon ke engines nitrogen ke oxides, CO aur bina jale hydrocarbons jaisi harmful gases chhorte hain. Zyada tar cars mein catalytic converter laga hota hai jo in harmful pollutants ko harmless (nuqsan na dene wali) cheezon mein badal deta hai: CO oxidise ho kar CO₂ banti hai; NOₓ reduce ho kar N₂ banti hain; aur bina jale hydrocarbons CO₂ aur H₂O mein badal jate hain.

DPF naye diesel engines mein lagaya jata hai taake exhaust gases se harmful particulate matter (PM) kam nikle. Is ka asal kaam exhaust gases se soot (kalikh) ke particles ko capture (pakarna) aur store (jama) karna hai.

SCR diesel engines mein exhaust gases se pollutants hatane ke liye istemal hota hai. Yeh TiO₂ aur zeolites jaise catalysts ki madad se NOₓ ko reduce kar ke N₂ banata hai, aur CO aur hydrocarbons ko oxidise kar ke CO₂ aur water vapour banata hai.

blocks.alt: Exhaust saaf karne ki line. Engine se teer NOx, CO, HC aur PM ko Oxidation Catalyst mein le jata hai, phir patli nali jahan neeli urea line Urea Dosing System (sabz cone) par andar aati hai, phir chauda dabba jis mein Urea SCR block aur NH3 Oxidate Catalyst block hain. Teer N2, CO2, H2O aur PM ke saath bahar nikalta hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 14.6: Selective Catalytic Reduction (kitab ki Figure 14.6 ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Pehle oxidation catalyst CO aur hydrocarbons (HC) ko CO₂ aur H₂O mein badalta hai. Phir urea dosing system urea ka spray dalta hai, jo garmi se NH₃ deta hai; SCR catalyst par yeh NH₃ NOₓ ko N₂ aur paani mein badal deti hai. Aakhri NH₃ oxidate catalyst bachi hui NH₃ ko khatam karta hai.

Scrubbers bohat se pollutants ko control kar sakte hain, jaise particulate matter, SO₂, HCl, NH₃ aur VOCs. Scrubbers liquids (maslan H₂O) istemal kar ke factories ki exhaust gases se SO₂ aur PM jaise pollutants hatate hain.

blocks.prompt: Catalytic converter gariyon ka harmful dhuan kaise kam karta hai, aur air pollution kam karne ki doosri strategies kya hain?
blocks.explanation: Converter ke andar catalyst CO ko CO₂ mein aur bina jale hydrocarbons ko CO₂ aur H₂O mein oxidise karta hai, aur NOₓ ko N₂ mein reduce karta hai, sab exhaust ke bahar nikalne se pehle. Doosri strategies: diesel engines par DPF aur SCR, factories par scrubbers, CNG, LPG aur low-sulphur diesel jaise saaf fuels, aur renewable energy jo jalne ki zaroorat hi khatam kar deti hai.

items: Catalytic converter: CO → CO₂, NOₓ → N₂, HC → CO₂ + H₂O.
DPF: soot pakarta hai. SCR: TiO₂, zeolites par NOₓ → N₂. Scrubbers: liquid se PM, SO₂, HCl, NH₃, VOCs hatate hain.
